title: Slack workspaces and messages
whyItMatters: Slack keeps downloaded files, cached channel history and the signed-in workspaces on the computer. It shows which employers and teams the person belonged to.
source: Slack desktop is an Electron app with user data in the app-data folder (per-workspace cache and downloads): https://slack.com/help
notes: Classic desktop client. Slack also ships as an MSIX package: Slack documents its user data at %LOCALAPPDATA%/Packages/com.tinyspeck.slackdesktop_8yrtsj140pw4g/LocalCache/Roaming/Slack (https://slack.com/help/articles/212475728-Deploy-Slack-for-Windows); older package IDs end in 8she8kybcnzg4. This rule covers the classic folder only. Cached messages are readable in the local store.

cleanup.exportFirst: Download any file or message you need from Slack first, because only the local cache is removed here.
cleanup.signOut: In Slack, sign out of each workspace, then sign out all other sessions from your account settings.
steps: Uninstall Slack from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Slack folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes cached channel history and downloads for every workspace signed in on this PC.
cleanup.source: Slack Help Center, Sign out of Slack: https://slack.com/help/articles/214613347-Sign-out-of-Slack
